hook: Akvan could dump up to *204 mm* on 4 Telangana districts
hook_b: Akvan could dump up to *204 mm* on 4 Telangana districts
tldr: IMD Hyderabad scaled up its Cyclone Akvan warnings: heavy to very heavy rain and 50-60 kmph squally winds are likely in Bhadradri Kothagudem, Khammam, Suryapet and Mahabubabad on Nov 20-21.

beats.what: IMD forecasts dry, chilly weather for three days, then rain and thundershowers in eastern districts from Nov 19, turning heavy on Nov 20-22.
beats.why: Cyclone Akvan is approaching the Andhra coast, and its rain bands are expected to spread over eastern and southeastern Telangana.
beats.care: Trips by road or rail to Khammam, Warangal or Bhadrachalam side on Nov 20-22 may run into heavy rain and strong winds.
